raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 7, Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscopied Léo Joannon’s death year as 1996 instead of 1969 (sources showed 1904–1969), leading to the incorrect conclusion that Excursion Train’s director died later; in fact, John Sturges (d. 1992) died later than Joannon (d. 1969).
